apps.name: Ghost Hub
apps.description: Every Ghost app in one place. Install and update them anywhere, from GitHub or your PC.
changes: Works anywhere now: apps download from GitHub on mobile data, at school or on any Wi-Fi. Your PC isn't needed.
At home it can still use your PC if GitHub can't be reached. Choose in Settings > Get apps from.
Longer waits on slow connections, and clearer messages when there's no internet.

apps.name: Ghost GPS
apps.description: Set your location anywhere: teleport, walk a route or steer with the joystick.
changes: Brand-new look to match Ghost GPS for iPhone: full-screen map with a floating search card and one big "Move me here" button.
Favourites show as one-tap chips above the button (long-press one to remove it). Tabs now have names: Teleport, Walk, Joystick.
Just GPS now: opens straight to the map. The VPN lives in Ghost VPN. The Dark map style is fixed too.

apps.name: Ghost Volume
apps.description: Your own volume for every app, switched automatically when you open it.
changes: Fixed: pop-ups, the volume panel and game overlays no longer snap the volume back to normal while you're still in an app.
Music keeps its own volume in the background: leave Spotify or YouTube and it stays at its level while it plays.
New design: a Now card shows what you're hearing and through what, every app gets its own slider, and a quick Add an app screen.
Your normal volume is saved safely, so it always comes back, even if Android restarts Ghost Volume.

apps.name: Ghost Terminal
apps.description: A shell on your phone, with a side list of commands that work on your device.
changes: New keys row: Tab, arrows, | > && / ~ - " * and Ctrl-C.
Tab completes command names and file/folder names like a real shell; ↓ goes forward in history.

apps.name: Ghost Weather
apps.description: Live weather where you are and anywhere you save: hourly, 7-day, rain alerts at a glance.
changes: Home-screen widget with the current weather (long-press your home screen › Widgets › Ghost Weather).
Share forecast from the menu.

apps.name: Ghost School
apps.description: Homework, timetable, grades, targets, exams and revision, with XP, levels and badges.
changes: Timetable tab, with what's on now and next on Home.
Exam countdowns, and targets per subject (tap a subject in Grades).
XP, levels and 17 badges to unlock, plus a daily goal ring and a 12-week study map.
Flashcards: paste a whole list at once, and an Answer first mode.
Quick-fire: new Squares & roots and Percentages modes.
Star important homework, back up and restore all your data, and a centred bottom bar.

apps.name: Ghost Image Editor
apps.description: Crop, rotate, filters, adjust, draw and add text to your photos. Nothing leaves your phone.
changes: Bottom tool bar and panels are now properly centred.
Emoji stickers and a Vignette slider.

apps.name: Ghost VPN
apps.description: One-tap VPN through free volunteer servers in many countries. Tests servers from your phone to find the fastest.
changes: Data used this session, shown under the timer.
Recent countries as one-tap chips, and an option to connect when you open the app.

apps.name: Ghost Browser
apps.description: A private browser: ad & tracker blocker, incognito tabs, and sites forget you when you leave.
changes: Pull down to refresh.
Add to start page: pin your own sites next to the shortcuts (long-press to remove).
Plus the security update: incognito tabs, forget me, site security panel, stronger ad blocker.

apps.name: Ghost Video
apps.description: Video editor: trim, filters, colour, speed, rotate, captions and sound. Saved on your phone.
changes: Tool bar spread evenly and centred, and panel buttons centred.
Save a frame as a photo (📸).
